22208.d: The Abandoned Farm or Eastern Ruins, more commonly referred to simply as the Ruins, are the remains of an ancient settlement in the eastern Wilderness.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The quest version of the ruins in Spirit Realm, Summer's farm, should be accessed from the Spirit of Summer quest start point, just northeast of Varrock. 
• Games necklace teleport to the Corporeal Beast. Exit the cave and run south. (Requires completion of Summer's End)
• Wilderness Crater lodestone teleport, then run north-east to the ruins.
• Take a canoe into the Wilderness. Run southeast to the ruins.
• Carrallangar Teleport to Graveyard of Shadows, exit east or west, then run north.
• The ancient obelisk along with the obelisk shard and portable obelisk, exit east or west, then run north.

gt.heading: Transportation
gt.text:
The Ruins are in close proximity to the Corporeal Beast's lair, which makes reaching it fairly simple. By using a Games necklace to teleport to it, then walking to the Ruins, it is possible to reach the area very quickly.

Not far to the south, below the Graveyard of Shadows, is a Wilderness obelisk, which allows players to travel to other obelisks found at different locations within the Wilderness. Before completing the hard Wilderness achievements this method of travel is unreliable because players are unable to choose their destination, but afterwards players can right-click the obelisk and choose which one they would like to teleport to. The Graveyard of Shadows obelisk is in Level 18 Wilderness.

Alternatively, players may reach the Ruins by running north from Varrock or north-east from Edgeville.

22234.d: The Rune Essence mine is a magical mine located in a cave in the mountains east of the Fremennik Province.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
There are a number of NPCs located around Gielinor that will teleport the player to the mine. Players can either talk to these NPCs and ask to go to the mine, or right click the NPC and click the "Teleport" option to go directly to the mine.

To leave the mine, you must enter a portal that can be very hard to see against the snowy background. An easy way to find it is to look for the Transportation arrow icon on the minimap.

Free-to-play
• Carwen Essencebinder - Located in Burthorpe. This is the closest location to a lodestone, and the shortest distance from a bank.
• Aubury - Located in Varrock, immediately south of the east bank.
• Archmage Sedridor - Located on the floor 2 of the Wizards' Tower. Stardust stored in the currency pouch acts as a one-click fast teleport to the balcony outside his room, and War's Retreat Teleport offers a fast teleport close to a bank chest once it is unlocked from the War's Wares for 10 boss kills.
• There is a deposit box in the Runecrafting Guild (50 Runecrafting required) inside the portal on the first floor. Do note that the deposit box located outside the Runecrafting Guild on the roof of the Wizards' Tower will NOT work for depositing essence, and will instead provide the message "Sedridor does not want you banking rune essence inside the tower."

Members
• Wizard Distentor - Located in the Magic Guild in Yanille. This location is preferred by many players due to its short distance from a bank, although level 66 or higher Magic is required to enter the guild.
• Wizard Cromperty - Located in East Ardougne, north-east of the marketplace. This location has a fairly-medium distance from a bank.
• Gnome Wizard Brimstail - Located in a cave in the south western corner of the Tree Gnome Stronghold, not recommended due to being far from a bank.
• Lunar Isle - This mine is a completely separate location from the magical ice mountain fields and is found inside the Lunar Isle mine. This location is not recommended due to its distance from the bank and because of the Suqahs on the way to the mine. Part of the Lunar Diplomacy quest must also be completed to use the bank on Lunar Isle. After completing Lunar Diplomacy player can use Home Teleport to the Lunar Isle lodestone or switch to Lunar Spells and use Moonclan Teleport, if they have 69 Magic, for price of 3 spots (2 astral, 1 law and 2 earth runes).

22256.d: Runecrafting is a free-to-play artisan skill released with the launch of RuneScape 2.

gt.heading: Entering rune temples
gt.text:
To enter a rune temple, players must have either a talisman that matches the current rune temple players are trying to enter (or omni-talisman for level 50 and above), then 'use' it on the altar. Alternatively, players can use a tiara or the wicked hood infused with the power of a talisman (this can be done inside the altar with a plain tiara and the talisman they used to enter the rune temple or by using them on the hood). The tiara or wicked hood is recommended because equipping it saves a backpack space. It allows entry into the altar with one click. Altars can also be teleported to through the special ability of the wicked hood and/or using pre-made teleport tabs from The Great Orb Project minigame. Talisman staves may also be obtained from this minigame. These work the same way as tiaras (they are infused with the desired talisman) but can also be used as a weak melee weapon.

Talismans

Runecrafting talismans are the primary version of the three items which allow players access to the rune temples. Each altar has an individual mysterious ruins which reacts only with the corresponding talisman. For example, use of an air talisman is needed to enter the air rune temple, whereas attempting to use a water talisman on the air altar will not produce any result at all. Talismans can be used on altars to create tiaras and staves. Some types of talisman are harder to obtain and can cost quite a lot of money on the Grand Exchange. However, tiaras are often cheaper as creating tiaras is a way to earn Runecrafting experience.

Most talismans have a 'locate' option, which causes them to function as something of a compass. The result of using the Locate option will be an indication of the direction of the mysterious ruins corresponding to the talisman being used, as related to the players current location, such as north-east. The message is generated in the chatbox.

Since talismans occupy an backpack space and rune essence is not stackable, talismans quickly become a hindrance to players attempting to utilise the skill as well as those simply attempting to train. As such, most players who are seriously committed to Runecrafting quickly upgrade to tiaras or talisman staves at the first opportunity.

There are two talismans that are not directly related to a single altar. The elemental talisman is a multi-key type of talisman which functions for the air, water, earth, and fire altars, but no others. Unfortunately, this talisman has no tiara or staff form, and is members only, severely limiting its usefulness. The other special talisman is the coveted omni-talisman, which is also members only. The omni-talisman is untradeable, but unlike the elemental talisman, it may be bound into a tiara or staff form. As it is untradeable and may only be obtained within the [[Runecrafting Guild], this talisman may be considered to have an indirect requirement of level 50 Runecrafting to use. The omni-talisman, and its related accessories, provide universal access to all altars.

Tiaras

Tiaras are headpieces crafted by players from silver bars. Blank tiaras may be imbued with the key-like function of a talisman, which cannot then be changed or removed. An imbued tiara becomes essentially an equipable version of whatever talisman was bound into it. As this frees an inventory slot and gives the player the ability to directly enter a mysterious ruin, without a series of clicks, tiaras are extraordinarily convenient. All tiaras except omni-tiaras are tradeable, and some (but not all) are quite valuable.

To bind a tiara, a player must take a talisman and blank tiara to the altar which matches the talisman they intend to bind. With both items in their inventory, the player must use either item on the altar to initiate the binding process and receive experience. Making tiaras does not have level requirements, so players with no Runecrafting experience may immediately begin binding body or higher talismans for accelerated experience at low levels.

The omni-tiara is bound by Wizard Korvak in the Runecrafting Guild, not at an altar. The player will need to bring him an omni-talisman and a blank tiara. The result is quite ornate in appearance, and functions to provide the player with universal access to the altars while worn. The omni-tiara provides the same single click entry option as all other tiaras.

Talisman staves

Talisman staves are the final type of talisman accessory, which functions both as a weak weapon as well as an equippable item which allows access to runecrafting altars through the mysterious ruins. Talisman staves are untradeable. Just as tiaras, they provide players with a simple left-click to enter the ruins. These staves provide no assistance in magic and will not substitute for the runes they are related to in any way. As such these items are usually just considered to be the symbol of an elite runecrafter.

A blank runecrafting staff can be purchased as an expensive reward from The Great Orb Project minigame, is untradeable, and cannot be wielded while blank. The process of attaching a talisman to the staff is identical to the process of binding a tiara. The player must take both the runecrafting staff and the talisman they wish to attach to it to the corresponding altar, and use one of the two items on the altar. Unlike creating tiaras, this action does not give the player Runecrafting experience. Players are unable to change the talisman type once the staff is bound. As a blank staff takes many hours of work to obtain, players should carefully consider which staff they want to bind. Completed runecrafting staves are also untradeable, and they can not be dropped; if a player is killed while wielding a talisman staff it will be destroyed (unless included in the 3 items kept on death).

The omni-talisman staff is not created at an altar. The Omni-talisman and a blank runecrafting staff are bound together within the Runecrafting Guild by Wizard Korvak. The law talisman staff is unique in the fact that it has no stat bonuses. Because of this, it is allowed onto Entrana allowing the player to reach the law altar while wielding it, as the mysterious ruins of the law altar are located on Entrana.

The wicked hood (when fed talismans or tiaras from any altar) allows the wearer to enter any runecrafting altar currently available to them and functions like a tiara allowing the user left click the altar. It can be obtained from Tam McGrubor in Burthorpe, or purchased from Wizard Finix's Runecrafting Shop for 175 Runespan points.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The guild can be accessed by entering the blue Runecrafting Guild portal on the top floor of the Wizards' Tower which is located south of Draynor Village.
• Wizards at every Runecrafting altar offer free teleports to the roof of the Wizard's Tower, then go through the portal into the Runecrafting Guild.
• Stardust in the currency pouch have a quick teleport to Wizard Rosalina in the Wizard's Tower, from where players can ascend to the top floor next to the portal to go to the Runecrafting Guild.
• Teleport to Draynor lodestone and run south to the Wizard's Tower, climb to the roof of the Wizard's Tower, then go through the portal into the Runecrafting Guild.
• Runecrafting Guild teleport tablets purchased in the guild offer a quick teleport to the guild.
• Teleport using the wicked hood. Then go through the portal into the Runecrafting Guild.
• Skills necklace will take the player straight there.
• Teleport to the entrance of the Wizard's Tower using the Traveller's necklace, climb to the roof of the Wizard's Tower, then go through the portal into the Runecrafting Guild.
• Members may use fairy ring code DIS to appear behind the Wizards' Tower, then climb to the roof of the Wizard's Tower, then go through the portal into the Runecrafting Guild.
• Members may teleport to the Wizard's Tower by going through the east portal on the top floor of the Wizard's guild (66 Magic required, boostable).

22283.d: The Runespan is a training area of Runecrafting.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Members can use wicked hood to teleport them in front of the low-level (south east) and mid-level (south west) portal to the Runespan. The law, death, blood, or infinity ethereal head pieces inherit this ability once acquired.
• Players can enter the top floor of Runespan via the Max Guild by attuning a skill portal to the high-level floor of Runespan. Additionally, Grace of the Elves can be used to teleport to the attuned teleport locations remotely.
• Runecrafting guild teleports can be used to go directly to the Runecrafting guild. Then exit the portal and re-enter choosing the Runespan location.
• Stardust in the currency pouch have a quick teleport to Wizard Rosalina in the Wizard's Tower, from where players can ascend to the top floor where the Runespan portals are located.
• Wizards are stationed at every Runecrafting altar and will offer to teleport players to the Wizards' Tower after a brief conversation. Fastest travel method for free-to-play is bring an air talisman, use skull sceptre to teleport outside Stronghold of Security, run to the air ruins, and talk to the wizard inside. 
• Players can teleport to Draynor Village and walk to the Wizards' Tower.
• Members can teleport to the tower by going through the eastern portal on the floor 3 of the Wizards' Guild (requires level 66 Magic).
• Members can use the fairy ring code DIS, taking them to the south of the tower.
